title: Ten more marks
intro: All ten use one green and its tints and stay calm. Each is shown large, next to the wordmark, and at real favicon sizes of 16 and 32px.

marks.name: Split square
marks.blurb: A square cut by one diagonal slit. The Z is only the space between the halves.
marks.svg: <path d="M14 14H46L14 46Z" fill="{accent}" stroke="{accent}" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"></path><path d="M50 22V50H22Z" fill="{accent}" stroke="{accent}" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"></path>

marks.name: Origami
marks.blurb: A Z folded from one strip of paper, in three tones of the same green, with each face catching different light.
marks.svg: <path d="M14 16H50L40 25H14Z" fill="{accent}"></path><path d="M50 16L40 25L14 48L24 39Z" fill="{soft}"></path><path d="M24 39H50V48H14Z" fill="{deep}"></path>

marks.name: Constellation
marks.blurb: Seven points: two dark rows joined by a light diagonal of three. It reads as a pattern first, and as a Z on a second look.
marks.svg: <circle cx="17" cy="17" r="4.6" fill="{accent}"></circle><circle cx="32" cy="17" r="4.6" fill="{accent}"></circle><circle cx="32" cy="47" r="4.6" fill="{accent}"></circle><circle cx="47" cy="47" r="4.6" fill="{accent}"></circle><circle cx="47" cy="17" r="4.6" fill="{soft}"></circle><circle cx="32" cy="32" r="4.6" fill="{soft}"></circle><circle cx="17" cy="47" r="4.6" fill="{soft}"></circle>

marks.name: River stone
marks.blurb: A soft Z worn into a smooth pebble. It’s the most organic and tactile of the ten.
marks.svg: <path d="M32 8C48 8 57 18 56.5 32C56 47 45 56 31 56C16 56 7.5 46 7.5 32C7.5 17 17 8 32 8Z" fill="{accent}"></path><path d="M21 23H40C44.5 23 45.5 27.5 41.5 29.5L23 36.5C18.5 38.5 19.5 42 24 42H43" fill="none" stroke="{paper}" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path>

marks.name: Window
marks.blurb: An arched window with a low moon. It feels like somewhere calm to come back to, and it has no letterform at all.
marks.svg: <path d="M19 50V31A13 13 0 0 1 45 31V50Z" fill="{accent}"></path><circle cx="32" cy="31" r="5.5" fill="{paper}"></circle><rect x="12" y="50" width="40" height="3.5" rx="1.75" fill="{soft}"></rect>

marks.name: Tide
marks.blurb: A circle split by a Z-shaped shoreline into water and sky. It’s calm, and the Z only shows up on a second look.
marks.svg: <defs><clipPath id="tide{uid}"><circle cx="32" cy="32" r="25"></circle></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#tide{uid})"><rect width="64" height="64" fill="{soft}"></rect><path d="M0 0H64V41H25L39 23H0Z" fill="{accent}"></path></g>

marks.name: Two rooms
marks.blurb: Two soft squares that overlap at one corner: separate products under one roof.
marks.svg: <defs><clipPath id="room{uid}"><rect x="11" y="11" width="29" height="29" rx="7"></rect></clipPath></defs><rect x="11" y="11" width="29" height="29" rx="7" fill="{soft}"></rect><rect x="24" y="24" width="29" height="29" rx="7" fill="{accent}"></rect><rect x="24" y="24" width="29" height="29" rx="7" fill="{deep}" clip-path="url(#room{uid})"></rect>

marks.name: Stencil
marks.blurb: A Z made of three separate strokes with small gaps, like a hand-cut stencil. Light and precise.

marks.name: Interlock
marks.blurb: Two matching corners turned to face each other, so they fit together and outline a Z between them.
marks.svg: <path d="M14 17H45V31" fill="none" stroke="{accent}" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path><path d="M19 33V47H50" fill="none" stroke="{soft}" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path>

marks.name: Journey
marks.blurb: A single line drawn as a Z that stops at a resting point. It suggests a path with somewhere to arrive.
marks.svg: <path d="M18 20H45L19 44H38" fill="none" stroke="{accent}" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"></path><circle cx="48" cy="44" r="4.5" fill="{soft}"></circle>
